title: Style
description: One named style: definition, lineage, visual grammar, classification rubric, agent rules, and measurable fingerprint. Rich-text fields use the same markup as references.

naming.description: historical: an established movement name. internet-aesthetic: a recent community name. industry: a name used by designers and vendors. curatorial: a name this catalogue made.

summary.description: Rich text. Short line for style cards.

lede.description: Rich text. Definition shown under the title.

identifiers.description: External IDs. wikidata: a Q number. aat: a Getty AAT ID. Record only IDs that you checked.

attestation.description: Sources that use this name for this style.

label.description: Name of a style outside this catalogue.

note.description: Rich text. The evidence or reasoning for the link.

synthesis.description: Rich text paragraphs. What connects the references.

rubric.description: The written test that a person or a model applies to classify a candidate.

counter.description: Traits that rule the style out.

with.description: A style id, or a plain name.

rules.description: Instructions for an agent that implements the style.

uses.description: Product types that suit the style.

avoid.description: Product types and contexts that suit the style badly. Say why.

fingerprint.description: Expected ranges for metrics from tools/extract-traits.js. tools/lint-style.mjs checks a capture against them.

detectorExceptions.description: Findings of the Impeccable detector on this style's specimen that tools/impeccable.mjs accepts. An empty array means the specimen is checked and needs no exceptions.

rule.description: An Impeccable rule id, for example tight-leading.

match.description: A regular expression that the finding's snippet must match. Name the value or element, so other findings of the same rule still fail.

kind.description: trait: the finding is part of this style. content: it comes from the shared specimen content, not the style. detector: the detector misreads the page.

reason.description: Why the finding is not a defect. Cite the style's grammar or rules when kind is trait.

preview.description: Reference ids whose first images show on the style card.
